rows.basis: The FY2023 MD&A names data centers, together with chip plants, food, pet food and pharmaceuticals, as sectors where demand was particularly strong (stmt:FIX|mdna|2023-12-31|e35e1f2d|revenue|FY2023|actual|0), with no figure. The Mechanical and Electrical segments are trade lines, not data-center lines. This is data center, not AI.

The FY2024 MD&A says demand was particularly strong in the technology sector, such as data centers and chip plants (stmt:FIX|mdna|2024-12-31|9e45922f|revenue|FY2024|actual|0), with no amount or share. Mechanical revenue of $5.53B and Electrical revenue of $1.50B are not data-center lines and are not summed. This is data center, not AI.

The FY2025 MD&A says demand was especially strong in the technology sector, particularly for data centers (stmt:FIX|mdna|2025-12-31|5da4d64a|revenue|FY2025|actual|0), with no amount or share. Mechanical revenue of $6.67B and Electrical revenue of $2.43B are trade segments, not data-center lines. Call-coverage attributions of bookings to technology are a call, not a release or filing, and are not used. This is data center, not AI.
